INSTRUCTIONS FOR FILLING THIS FORM
1. This Form shall be made up to the date of AGM of the Company or the last date of the calendar year
where no AGM is held/concluded during the year.
2. If shares are of different classes the columns should be subdivided, so that the number of each
class held, is shown separately against S. No. 2.7 and 2.8

EC

3. If space provided is insufficient, the required information should be listed in a separate sheet
attached to this return which should also be signed.

TR
U

4. This form is to be filed within 30 days of the date indicated in Sr. No. 2.1 or 2.2 (as the case may
be). If the form is filed after 30 days, additional fee as per section 468 shall be applicable.
5. An inactive company or a company which held its AGM but the same was not concluded shall file
Form-A within a period of 30 days from the close of calendar year.
6. This form is not applicable on single member companies & private companies having paid-up capital
not exceeding 3.0 million in case there is no change of particulars since last annual return filed with
the registrar.

ED

7. A company, other than a single member company or a private company having paid up capital of not
more than three million rupees, shall inform the registrar on Form-24 that there is no change of
particulars in the last annual return filed with the registrar.

IFI

8. In Serial No. 2.11 mention registration number of auditor & legal advisor that is body corporate
registered with relevant authority

CE
RT

9. Original challan or other evidence of payment of fee specified in Seventh Schedule of the Act will be
submitted with this form (not applicable in case of online filing)
